editorial: Mono fold-down, silence trim with pre-roll, constant peak normalization, short edge fades. No synthesis or pitch variants.
provider_history_limit: ElevenLabs history API explicitly excludes SFX. One completed response lost during initial validation is preserved as raw/vase-01.json and replaced by distinct vase-03 prompt.
task_id_policy: Missing synchronous provider IDs are null, never replaced with invented task IDs.
